## National Land Cover Dataset (NLCD)

```{r Download & Plot NLCD Map}
#| code-summary: "NLCD Map"
#| code-line-numbers: "|1-4|6-7|9-10"
#| code-fold: true
#| 
# Download data using our helper function
download_data(
  url = "https://www.mrlc.gov/downloads/sciweb1/shared/mrlc/data-bundles/Annual_NLCD_LndCov_2024_CU_C1V1.zip",
  relative_dir = "nlcd/Annual_NLCD_LndCov_2024_CU_C1V1.zip")

# Point to data
nlcd <- rast("data_mid/nlcd/Annual_NLCD_LndCov_2024_CU_C1V1.zip/Annual_NLCD_LndCov_2024_CU_C1V1.tif")

# Static Plot
plot(nlcd)

```

::: {.notes }
National Land Cover Data set

Depicts the predominant thematic land cover class within the mapping year with respect to broad categories of artificial or natural surface cover

30m x 30m grid
105,000 x 160,000

:::

## NLCD in Manhattan

```{r Plot NLCD for Manhattan}
#| code-summary: "NLCD Manhattan"
#| code-line-numbers: "|1-4|6-7|9-13"

# Transform Manhattan County Shape to match NLCD
manhattan_county_nlcd <- census_county %>%
  filter(GEOID == "36061") %>%
  st_transform(crs(nlcd))

# Crop & Mask NLCD
nlcd_man <- crop(nlcd, manhattan_county_nlcd, mask = TRUE)

# Plot
leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addRasterImage(nlcd_man, opacity = 0.8) %>%
  addRasterLegend(nlcd_man, title = "NLCD Land Cover", opacity = 1)
```
